description: Craft Agents and Octomind through their vendors' PowerShell installers, and Codewhale and Momentic's Mo from npm, on Windows, installed and not run.
why: Octomind's witness is its launcher under %LOCALAPPDATA%\octomind\bin\ alone, and each npm package is its agent's only witness, because neither CLI is run. Craft Agents has more than one: the Uninstall key its installer writes, the launcher install-app.ps1 adds, and ~\.craft-agent once the app has started, so require_rows holds the first two and removing either value leaves the rest to find it. claude-code and claude-desktop are forbidden because Craft Agents embeds the Claude Agent SDK and its native `claude` binary, pi because it embeds the Pi SDK, deepseek-harness because Codewhale started as deepseek-tui and defaults to DeepSeek's models, and hermes and warp because their launchers are read by the same per-user branch.
known_gaps: Installed, never run, and never signed in: what each agent writes on first use is not read here.
Codewhale's winget package and its own archive installer, which writes %USERPROFILE%\bin, are not exercised; no Windows branch reads that directory.
